confirmation: prior-day trailing20 market return <0; today market >=1%; stock >6% and >market+2pp; positive body, wick<=body/3, volume>prior5 and prior10; price>=3, amount20>=30m
impulse: same stock candle/liquidity rules; market daily<=0 and trailing20 including impulse<0; most recent such day 5-30 market sessions before confirmation
intervening: market index at confirmation-1 below impulse close; no selection using post-confirmation prices
pullback: prior close 5-20% below highest close from impulse through confirmation-1; every intervening close >=pre-impulse close; last3 volume <=70% mean from impulse through known peak
resistant: entire waiting-phase maximum close-to-close drawdown <5%; every intervening close >=pre-impulse close; recovered-after-deep-dip kept separate
entry: confirmation+1 market session open; upper-limit open skipped; no 9.5% cap; historical ST excluded
exit: 5/10/20/30/60/120 sessions; entry is day1; hard15% stop default; T+1 and locked lower-limit delayed; same-entry no-stop control
repeated: first qualifying confirmation per stock/impulse for each setup group; same-stock nonoverlap separately by horizon, using common stop/no-stop exit
industry: prior-calendar-year-end dated CSRC industry snapshot; blank/future/unknown excluded; focal stock removed from peer daily returns and breadth
industry_confirmation: at least20 other members; sector prior5 return beats market prior5, sector today beats market, >=60% other members up
controls: Fixed v8 nonleader controls on same signal date, board and liquidity quartile; not selected by later returns.
split: entry<=2024 and entire stop/no-stop exit<=2024 training-description; signals>=2025 retrospective validation; cross-boundary excluded
limitations: Previously inspected history, no pristine holdout or proven absorption/causality.
Current TDX price universe omits some delisted stocks.
Annual lagged classifications can be stale; CSRC industry is not a theme/concept board.
Event statistics do not model portfolio capital or imply CAGR.
mandatory_bottom: At the FIRST impulse S: L=min adjusted close[S-60:S]; H=max adjusted close[S-120:floor+1]; decline>=30%, floor age<=8, close[S-1]<=1.08*L.
mandatory_long_decline: Primary profile requires last occurrence of original peak to floor>=60 stock sessions; pre-S MA60<MA60 at S-21<MA60 at S-41. A flat plateau followed by a recent crash must not count as a long decline.
comparison: macd_core retains original bottom rules without the new duration/trend requirement; long_decline is the primary profile. V8 broad stock selection is never the main profile.
anchor_selection: Choose most recent qualifying bottom impulse 5-30 market sessions before T, after applying the profile filters; do not first select a generic impulse then merely label its depth.
ranking: At T: clip(log(bull/bear mean volume over prior40),-1,1)+confirmed near MACD divergence+0.5*histogram recovery; descending, then amount20, then code.
ranking_scope: Ordering of same-day candidate watchlists only. Event averages do not model capital/slots and do not quantify ranking alpha.
confirmation_floor_distance: Explicitly report T-1 close/L-1 and actual buy/L-1. The old8% rule is mandatory at S, not silently reapplied after the waiting phase; near8 at T is an additional diagnostic.
execution_change: None versus v8: next open, no9.5% cap, hard15% stop, same horizons/cost. This isolates the restored selection rules.
